Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure sets four cylinder-and-piston drawings side by side as the successive steps of a cycle. Each cylinder holds a gray region stippled with dots for the gas, capped by a piston whose stem rises from the open top, and each stands inside a large colored block representing its surroundings. In the first, a red block labeled "Reservoir" and "(Temperature Th)" sends a thick gray arrow Qh upward into the gas while a green arrow W1 points up from the piston stem. The second sits in a pale block labeled "Insulation", green arrow W2 pointing up and the gas column taller. The third stands in a blue "Reservoir" block marked "(Temperature Tc)", with a green arrow W3 pointing down onto the piston and a gray arrow Qc leaving downward. The fourth returns to an "Insulation" block, with W4 pointing down and the gas at its shortest column. Bold captions run beneath: "Step 1: Isothermal expansion", "Step 2: Adiabatic expansion", "Step 3: Isothermal compression", and "Step 4: Adiabatic compression", each followed by a transition written M to N, N to O, O to P, and P to M. Left to right, block color, arrow direction, and gas volume shift together to track where heat crosses the boundary and which way work is done. The sequence lays out the four processes of the Carnot cycle for an ideal gas.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Button/state for the four Carnot steps: the learner clicks Next through M to N, N to O, O to P, and P to M, the active piston, heat arrow, work arrow, and reservoir or insulation block highlight, making clear the ordered expansion and compression processes in the cycle.
- Toggle between thermal contact and insulation: the learner selects isothermal or adiabatic steps, heat arrows appear only with the hot or cold reservoir and disappear inside insulation, making clear when energy crosses the boundary as heat.
- Toggle between piston panels and a p-V path view: the learner switches representations, the corresponding segment of the MNOP curve highlights as each cylinder state is selected, making clear how the physical piston motion maps to the thermodynamic cycle path.

SOURCE FILE: OpenStax University Physics, chapter 21: The Second Law of Thermodynamics

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

Step 1 of 4: Isothermal expansion (M→N) — gas in contact with the hot reservoir absorbs Qh and pushes the piston up, doing work W1.

// @FIGURE_CODE_BEGIN // LIBRARY: svgjs var draw = SVG().addTo(document.getElementById('container')).size('100%','100%'); var W = 1000, H = 520; draw.viewbox(0,0,W,H); var curStep = 0, showPV = false, showHeat = true; var STEPS = [ { caption:'Step 1: Isothermal expansion', trans:'(M→N)', narr:'Step 1 of 4: Isothermal expansion (M→N) — gas in contact with the hot reservoir absorbs Qh and pushes the piston up, doing work W1.', block:'#f2c1c1', blockLabel:'Reservoir', temp:'(Temperature Th)', gasTop:180, gasBot:300, wDir:-1, wLabel:'W1', qDir:-1, qLabel:'Qh', qAt:'bottom' }, { caption:'Step 2: Adiabatic expansion', trans:'(N→O)', narr:'Step 2 of 4: Adiabatic expansion (N→O) — the cylinder is insulated; no heat flows. The gas keeps expanding, does work W2, and cools from Th to Tc.', block:'#f7e7dd', blockLabel:'Insulation', temp:'', gasTop:100, gasBot:300, wDir:-1, wLabel:'W2', qDir:0, qLabel:'', qAt:null }, { caption:'Step 3: Isothermal compression', trans:'(O→P)', narr:'Step 3 of 4: Isothermal compression (O→P) — in contact with the cold reservoir, work W3 is done on the gas and heat Qc is expelled at Tc.', block:'#b6d2de', blockLabel:'Reservoir', temp:'(Temperature Tc)', gasTop:100, gasBot:300, wDir:1, wLabel:'W3', qDir:1, qLabel:'Qc', qAt:'bottom' }, { caption:'Step 4: Adiabatic compression', trans:'(P→M)', narr:'Step 4 of 4: Adiabatic compression (P→M) — insulated again; work W4 compresses the gas, warming it back to Th and closing the cycle.', block:'#f7e7dd', blockLabel:'Insulation', temp:'', gasTop:220, gasBot:300, wDir:1, wLabel:'W4', qDir:0, qLabel:'', qAt:null } ]; function arrow(g, x, y1, y2, color, width) { g.line(x, y1, x, y2).stroke({ color:color, width:width }); var dir = y2 < y1 ? -1 : 1; var tip = y2, s = 9; g.polygon([x, tip, x-6, tip - dir*s*1.4, x+6, tip - dir*s*1.4].join(',')).fill(color); } function gasDots(g, cx, top, bot, seed) { var s = seed; function rnd(){ s = (s*9301+49297)%233280; return s/233280; } for (var i=0;i<45;i++){ g.circle(4).center(cx-30+rnd()*60, top+8+rnd()*(bot-top-16)).fill('#555').opacity(0.8); } } function drawPanels() { draw.clear(); for (var i=0;i<4;i++){ var st = STEPS[i]; var g = draw.group(); var active = (i===curStep); var px = 20 + i*250; var cx = px+100; g.opacity(active?1:0.45); // surroundings block var blk = g.rect(190, 330).move(px+5, 10).fill(st.block) .stroke({ color: active?'#333':'#999', width: active?2.5:1 }); // cylinder walls (open top) g.line(cx-38, 60, cx-38, 302).stroke({color:'#666',width:2}); g.line(cx+38, 60, cx+38, 302).stroke({color:'#666',width:2}); g.line(cx-38, 302, cx+38, 302).stroke({color:'#666',width:2}); // gas g.rect(76, 300-st.gasTop).move(cx-38, st.gasTop).fill('#c9c9c9').opacity(0.55); gasDots(g, cx, st.gasTop, 300, 17+i*31); // piston g.rect(80, 14).move(cx-40, st.gasTop-14).fill('#9aa5b1').stroke({color:'#555',width:1}); g.rect(10, 34).move(cx-5, st.gasTop-48).fill('#9aa5b1').stroke({color:'#555',width:1}); // work arrow var wy = st.gasTop-52; arrow(g, cx+22, st.wDir<0 ? wy+38 : wy-8, st.wDir<0 ? wy-8 : wy+38, '#2e9e2e', 4); g.text(st.wLabel).move(cx+34, st.wDir<0? wy-34 : wy-30).font({size:20, style:'italic', family:'serif'}).fill('#222'); // heat arrow if (st.qDir!==0 && showHeat){ arrow(g, cx, st.qDir<0 ? 325 : 275, st.qDir<0 ? 275 : 325, '#777', 7); g.text(st.qLabel).move(cx-16, 330).font({size:20, style:'italic', family:'serif'}).fill('#333'); } // labels g.text(st.blockLabel).center(cx, 352).font({size:16, family:'sans-serif'}).fill('#222'); if (st.temp) g.text(st.temp).center(cx, 376).font({size:15, family:'sans-serif'}).fill('#222'); // captions g.text(function(add){ add.tspan(st.caption.split(': ')[0]+': ').font({weight:'bold'}); add.tspan(st.caption.split(': ')[1]).font({weight:'bold'}); }).center(cx, 410).font({size:15, family:'sans-serif'}).fill('#111'); g.text(st.trans).center(cx, 432).font({size:15, style:'italic', family:'serif'}).fill('#111'); // interactivity blk.css('cursor','pointer'); (function(idx,grp){ grp.on('click', function(){ curStep=idx; render(); showPopup(STEPS[idx].caption+' '+STEPS[idx].trans, STEPS[idx].narr); }); grp.on('mousemove', function(e){ showTooltip(STEPS[idx].caption+' '+STEPS[idx].trans, e); }); grp.on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); })(i,g); if (active){ g.rect(240, 440).move(px-15, 2).fill('none').stroke({color:'#2e7fd0',width:2.5}).radius(8).back(); } } } // Carnot cycle p-V data (world coords) var PV = { M:[1,4.5], N:[2,2.25], O:[4,0.853], P:[2,1.7] }; function pvX(v){ return 180 + v*180; } function pvY(p){ return 440 - p*90; } function pvCurve(fn, a, b, g, color, width, dash){ var pts=[]; for (var i=0;i<=40;i++){ var v=a+(b-a)*i/40; pts.push(pvX(v)+','+pvY(fn(v))); } var l=g.polyline(pts.join(' ')).fill('none').stroke({color:color,width:width,linecap:'round'}); if(dash) l.attr('stroke-dasharray','6,4'); return l; } function drawPV(){ draw.clear(); var g = draw.group(); // axes arrow(g, 150, 460, 150, 60, '#333', 2); arrow(g, 150, 460, 900, 460, '#333', 2); g.text('p').move(128, 50).font({size:22, style:'italic', family:'serif'}); g.text('V').move(905, 448).font({size:22, style:'italic', family:'serif'}); g.text('Carnot cycle on a p–V diagram').center(520, 30).font({size:16, family:'sans-serif'}).fill('#444'); var isoH = function(v){return 4.5/v;}, isoC = function(v){return 3.41/v;}; var ad1 = function(v){return 5.94/Math.pow(v,1.4);}, ad2 = function(v){return 4.5/Math.pow(v,1.4);}; var segs = [ function(){ return pvCurve(isoH,1,2,g,'#c0392b',4); }, function(){ return pvCurve(ad1,2,4,g,'#c0392b',4); }, function(){ return pvCurve(isoC,2,4,g,'#2c6fbb',4); }, function(){ return pvCurve(ad2,1,2,g,'#2c6fbb',4); } ]; var order=[0,1,2,3]; for (var k=0;k<4;k++){ var l = segs[k](); if (k!==curStep){ l.stroke({color: k<2?'#e0a8a0':'#a8c4dd', width:2.5}); } } // state points var names=['M','N','O','P'], keys=['M','N','O','P']; for (var j=0;j<4;j++){ var pt=PV[keys[j]]; g.circle(9).center(pvX(pt[0]),pvY(pt[1])).fill('#222'); g.text(names[j]).move(pvX(pt[0])-24, pvY(pt[1])-12).font({size:20, style:'italic', family:'serif'}); } g.text('hot isotherm Th').move(pvX(1.35), pvY(isoH(1.35))-28).font({size:13, family:'sans-serif'}).fill('#c0392b'); g.text('cold isotherm Tc').move(pvX(3.1), pvY(isoC(3.1))+12).font({size:13, family:'sans-serif'}).fill('#2c6fbb'); var lbl = g.text('Highlighted segment: '+STEPS[curStep].caption.replace('Step ','').replace(': ',': ')+' '+STEPS[curStep].trans) .center(520, 492).font({size:15, family:'sans-serif'}).fill('#111'); g.on('mousemove', function(e){ showTooltip('Click steps ◀ ▶ to trace M→N→O→P→M around the cycle', e); }); g.on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); g.on('click', function(){ showPopup('Carnot cycle path','Two isotherms (M→N at Th, O→P at Tc) joined by two adiabats (N→O, P→M). The enclosed area equals the net work output per cycle.'); }); g.css('cursor','pointer'); } function render(){ if (showPV) drawPV(); else drawPanels(); document.getElementById('demoNarration').textContent = STEPS[curStep].narr; document.getElementById('stepLabel').textContent = (curStep+1)+' / 4'; } function nextStep(){ curStep=(curStep+1)%4; render(); } function prevStep(){ curStep=(curStep+3)%4; render(); } function toggle_view(on){ showPV=on; render(); } function toggle_heat(on){ showHeat=on; render(); } render(); window.__markRendered(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
